text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin was doing strength training 
on the long stairs on the hill. However, 
she seemed to have lost focus, and her 
movements were sluggish...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Dammit...! I'm doing one more 
round-trip...
choice_data_list: Taishin, let's take a little break...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up! I don't need any of—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks for your hard work! You're 
really putting your heart into it.
choice_data_list:
North Flight... do you have the day off 
today?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, once we get back to the academy, I 
plan to do a little bit of it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still, today was the release day for that 
new dress I reserved! Hehehe♪ I even 
stopped by that trendy café while I was at 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, after returning to 
the academy, I spotted North Flight once 
again.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Alright... Haaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hurry, next! Something even 
tougher...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me for a moment. It looks like 
you're having some trouble... aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone... It has nothing to do 
with you...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...It may indeed have nothing to do with 
me. Even so, I cannot simply look away 
from an Umamusume who shares the same 
struggles as myself."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, neither I nor Taishin-san could 
flatteringly be called sturdy... right? 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To increase efficiency, a change of pace 
is essential!
choice_data_list: I see, good point! That's a great idea.
I see, good point! That's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
A change of pace...? I don't have time to 
goof around.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ I'm not just going to let you play 
around, you know? Today, by doing things 
you normally wouldn't, we're going to 
refresh your brain!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Taishin-san, please coordinate 
an outfit for Trainer-san! The theme is 
'Winter City Walk Wear'♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Why me?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So you have to think about things you 
wouldn't normally think about. Come on, 
just trust me on this...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...
choice_data_list: Taishin... if you don't want to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine... I'll do it! It might solve things, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was unfamiliar territory 
for her, she gave it serious thought. I 
was happy, so I bought the item I liked, 
and we decided to take a break at a cafe 
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Haaaaah*... I'm beat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"My head is spinning... Ah, I just want to 
run..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right? Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...! I get what you're trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her objectively, she seems 
refreshed. If she can thoroughly enjoy a 
change of pace today and give it her all 
again starting tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'm all good now. Heading back 
to resume training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What? You managed to refresh yourself, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Shall we head back soon, then? The 
moment motivation strikes is the best time 
to train.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*—! Well Trainer, how was that?
choice_data_list: Whoa...! That's the best time today
Whoa...! That's the best time today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright...! Next time, even more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin has certainly bounced back. 
Still, wouldn't it have been better if she 
rested a little longer...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're... worried, aren't you? I 
understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"If I stop Taishin-san now, she'll just 
get stubborn. So this is fine for today."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From now on, please watch over her for me, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A burning passion driven by the feeling 
that "I don't want to lose to anyone." 
Because of that, she can become 
unstoppable... I reminded myself that I 
need to be there to support her.
